extracted.intended_audience: cord-cutters and streaming shoppers researching Hulu + Live TV channel lineup and features
extracted.subtask_description: A consumer-facing article listing Hulu + Live TV plans, pricing, device support, channel lineup (local, cable, sports, RSNs, premium), add-ons, and market availability. Useful for people deciding whether Hulu Live TV meets their channel and regional needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device compatibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV works on major streaming devices including Apple TV, Roku, Fire TV, Chromecast, iOS, and Android.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If device support matters to you, confirm your specific model is listed; article states live TV is available on those mainstream platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plans and pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu Live TV has two plans (ads and no-ads) which include The Disney Bundle at no extra charge. Examples listed: Hulu + Live TV w/ The Disney Bundle (Ads): TBD/mo.; Hulu + Live TV w/ The Disney Bundle (No Ads): $82.99/mo. The article also references a $69.99/mo base plan and an $82.99/mo no-ads plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare ad vs no-ad plan pricing and what 'The Disney Bundle' (Disney+ and ESPN+) includes. Prices and exact plan names may vary; check current Hulu page for up-to-date amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Channel breadth and top-channel coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV includes over 70 channels, 33 of which are in cable’s top 35.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'top 35' coverage count to judge how closely Hulu replicates a typical cable package; article provides a table of top channels to compare presence/absence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local channel availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu Live TV includes live local channels such as CBS, NBC, FOX, ABC, and Telemundo. Live local channels are available in most of the top 200 cities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your local network affiliates are important, check whether your specific market is supported; if local live channels aren’t carried in your market you can often watch that content on-demand the following day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local channel travel restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: While you’re traveling, you can watch the local channels of the market you’re visiting (if available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local channel access is market-dependent when roaming; availability may differ when traveling—confirm the market’s support before relying on local live streams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unlimited cloud DVR and ad-skip features
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscription includes Unlimited cloud DVR storage, with the ability to skip through commercials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cloud DVR limits and commercial-skip behavior can be differentiators between services; article highlights these as benefits of Hulu + Live TV.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add-ons and pricing (Sports, Entertainment, Español)
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu + Live TV offers add-ons: Sports Add-on $10/mo., Entertainment Add-on $8/mo., Español Add-on $5/mo.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add-ons expand channel selection (e.g., Sports add-on includes NFL RedZone); verify which specific channels each add-on adds and whether regional restrictions apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top cable channels included / missing
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu Live TV offers 33 of the top 35 cable channels — examples include Bravo, CNN, Disney Channel, E!, ESPN, Fox News, MS NOW, TBS, TNT, and USA Network. It is missing AMC, Hallmark Channel, and WE tv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check whether any of the (few) missing top channels are deal-breakers for you; Entertainment Add-On may add more niche/older-entertainment channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: National sports channel availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu carries many top sports channels such as ESPN, FS1, Fox Sports 2, TBS, TNT, and USA Network. The service offers NFL RedZone as part of the Sports Add-On ($10).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For fans of particular national sports feeds, confirm carriage of channels like ESPN2, ESPNU, and specialized feeds; some premium sports feeds may require add-ons or are not carried.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regional Sports Networks (RSNs) policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu Live TV gives access to some RSNs, specifically NBC Sports RSNs (e.g., NBC Sports Philadelphia, NBC Sports Chicago). Hulu no longer carries Bally Sports RSNs, YES Network, or Marquee Sports Network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your local professional team’s RSN is on Bally/YES/Marquee, Hulu may not carry it—this is a common cord-cutter issue and affects live local/pro team viewing. Check for specific RSN availability in your region.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pro sports network carriage specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: The article states that with Hulu Live TV you can stream MLB Network and NFL RedZone, but do not carry NBA TV, NFL Network, and NHL Network (per the 'Pro Sports' section).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There are some inconsistencies across the article’s tables and prose about NFL Network; always verify carriage of specific pro-sports networks before subscribing if those channels matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: College sports channels availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Hulu Live TV offers some college sports channels including ACC Network, Big Ten Network, CBS Sports Network, ESPNU, and SEC Network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: College-sports fans should confirm conference/region-specific channel availability (e.g., Big Ten Network vs conference streaming options) and whether extras like ACC Network extra are included or require add-ons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other sports and specialty sports channels (add-on coverage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional sports channels available (some via Sports Add-On) include FanDuel TV, MAVTV, MLB Network Strike Zone, Outdoor Channel, Sportsman Channel, SportsNet NY, Tennis Channel, TVG, and TVG2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you follow niche sports or wagering networks, inspect the Sports Add-On channel list and any per-channel extra fees (the article shows some channels as +$10).

rubrics_metrics.name: Premium channel add-ons and pricing
rubrics_metrics.description: You can add HBO Max ($15), Showtime ($11), Cinemax ($10), and STARZ ($9) to your Hulu Live TV account. The Disney Bundle (Disney+ and ESPN+) is included at no extra charge with the plans discussed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Premium networks are sold as add-ons with monthly fees; check for current bundle promotions and whether the included Disney Bundle is the same across plans (ads vs no-ads).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive channel listing availability
rubrics_metrics.description: The article provides an 'All Channels on Hulu Live TV' section and a large table enumerating every channel offered on Hulu Live TV and the bundles/plans they appear in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the comprehensive list/table to confirm presence/absence of specific channels and to compare plan-by-plan availability; channel lineups and availability are market- and time-dependent, so verify on Hulu’s official lineup page.
